proposals.evidence: DEDR1: Kodagu aeŋga explicitly means those persons in the article’s remote demonstrative paradigm. Pattapu aŋgu has the same a-initial nasal-velar formation with contracted vocalism and final u. This comparison uses the animate plural pronoun, not the superficially similar Tamil aṅku there. Whole-article family membership is proposed; inheritance versus local transmission remains subject to review. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

DEDR3647 also lists Tamil nāṅkaḻ exclusive: the articles overlap, and5154 is preferred here for its Kodagu naŋga comparison; this is not a claim that3647 is unrelated.
